premise: The ship lifts off and its dust drifts slowly down over the solar panel; Maya brushes and brushes but it clings — until the panel tilts and lets it slide off.
inspiration: Sisyphus and his stone (Greek myth), the chore that never ends, turned: this chore ends when the panel lends a hand.
lesson: Two can do what one can't.

en-US.title: Sticky Dust
en-US.text: The huge {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} ship stood on the landing pad, ready to fly home. {woman:enter} Maya came loping out to see it off, {woman:face happy} and {woman:live} waved goodbye. {canvas:dust 0.8 10s} {ship:go away} Up it rose, and up rose a great cloud of dust. It hung in the sky… and drifted… slowly… down. All over the {solar-panel:enter} solar panel. {solar-panel:dust-puff} {woman:face sad} [sighs] Its sixteen blue cells were grey. Maya loped over {woman:go to solar-panel} and brushed. {sfx:brush} Brush, brush. {woman:shake 0.4} The dust clung on. Moon dust isn't round and smooth like sand on a beach. It's sharp and sticky. She brushed harder. Brush, brush, BRUSH! {woman:wobble} Still grey. [curious] Then the solar panel {solar-panel:live} tilted, slowly, up toward the Sun. {woman:face surprised} And as it tipped, the dust began to slide. A little. Then a lot. {solar-panel:dust-puff} {solar-panel:sparkle} {woman:face happy} [laughs] {woman:hop} Sixteen blue cells, shining again. Teamwork!

es-ES.title: Polvo pegajoso
es-ES.text: La enorme {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} nave esperaba en la plataforma de aterrizaje, lista para volver a casa. {woman:enter} Maya salió dando saltos a despedirla, {woman:face happy} y {woman:live} le dijo adiós con la mano. {canvas:dust 0.8 10s} {ship:go away} La nave subió, y con ella subió una gran nube de polvo. Se quedó flotando… y fue bajando… despacito… Justo encima del {solar-panel:enter} panel solar. {solar-panel:dust-puff} {woman:face sad} [sighs] Sus dieciséis celdas azules estaban grises. Maya fue dando saltos {woman:go to solar-panel} y lo cepilló. {sfx:brush} Cepilla, cepilla. {woman:shake 0.4} El polvo seguía pegado. El polvo de la Luna no es redondito y suave como la arena de la playa. Es afilado y pegajoso. Cepilló más fuerte. Cepilla, cepilla, ¡CEPILLA! {woman:wobble} Seguía gris. [curious] Entonces el panel solar {solar-panel:live} se inclinó, despacio, hacia el Sol. {woman:face surprised} Y al inclinarse, el polvo empezó a resbalar. Un poco. Luego mucho. {solar-panel:dust-puff} {solar-panel:sparkle} {woman:face happy} [laughs] {woman:hop} Dieciséis celdas azules, brillando otra vez. ¡Trabajo en equipo!

brush.prompt: a soft brush sweeping fine gritty dust off a smooth glass panel, two strokes
